import importlib.util
import json
import os
import re
import subprocess

inv = {'paths': {'topics': ['/home/ssm-user/kafka_2.12-2.8.1/bin/kafka-topics.sh'], 'configs': ['/home/ssm-user/kafka_2.12-2.8.1/bin/kafka-configs.sh'], 'jars': ['/home/ssm-user/kafka_2.12-2.8.1/libs/aws-msk-iam-auth-2.3.0-all.jar'], 'properties': ['/home/ssm-user/kafka_2.12-2.8.1/bin/client.properties']}, 'properties': [{'path': '/home/ssm-user/kafka_2.12-2.8.1/bin/client.properties', 'required_settings_match': True, 'credential_override_present': False, 'unknown_keys': []}], 'principal_arn': 'arn:aws:sts::048715026902:assumed-role/ktd-msk-producer-role/i-08e374efb0c31160d', 'java_present': True, 'javac_present': False, 'credential_env_present': {'AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID': False, 'AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY': False, 'AWS_SESSION_TOKEN': False, 'AWS_PROFILE': False, 'AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE': False, 'AWS_CONFIG_FILE': False, 'JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS': False, 'KAFKA_OPTS': False}, 'shared_credential_files_exist': []}
env = dict(os.environ)
env['CLASSPATH'] = inv['paths']['jars'][0]
env['KAFKA_HEAP_OPTS'] = '-Xms64M -Xmx256M'
broker = 'boot-aersevd2.c2.kafka-serverless.ap-northeast-2.amazonaws.com:9098'
props = inv['paths']['properties'][0]
results = {'topic_describes': {}, 'configs': {}, 'client_version': None}
version = subprocess.run([inv['paths']['topics'][0], '--version'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20, env=env)
results['client_version'] = version.stdout.strip()
for topic in ('kitchen.sensor.raw', 'kitchen.sensor.validated', 'kitchen.sensor.quarantine'):
    pattern = '^' + re.escape(topic) + '$'
    command = [inv['paths']['topics'][0], '--bootstrap-server', broker, '--command-config', props, '--describe', '--topic', pattern]
    proc = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=45, env=env)
    results['topic_describes'][topic] = {'command': command, 'returncode': proc.returncode, 'stdout': proc.stdout, 'stderr': proc.stderr}
    print(json.dumps({'topic': topic, **results['topic_describes'][topic]}), flush=True)
    if topic != 'kitchen.sensor.raw' and proc.returncode == 0 and re.search(r'Topic:\s*' + re.escape(topic) + r'\s', proc.stdout):
        command = [inv['paths']['configs'][0], '--bootstrap-server', broker, '--command-config', props, '--entity-type', 'topics', '--entity-name', topic, '--describe', '--all']
        cfg = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=45, env=env)
        results['configs'][topic] = {'command': command, 'returncode': cfg.returncode, 'stdout': cfg.stdout, 'stderr': cfg.stderr}
results['python_kafka_present'] = importlib.util.find_spec('kafka') is not None
results['python_signer_present'] = importlib.util.find_spec('aws_msk_iam_sasl_signer') is not None
print('RESULT_JSON=' + json.dumps(results), flush=True)
